title: Normalized exactness of contravariant internal derived Hom
statement: On an arbitrary small ringed site with commutative coefficients in independent universes, let H be the recorded unbounded derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and T_M(X)=H(X,M). There is a coherent integer shift structure on T_M from the opposite triangulated category, making T_M triangulated. Its degree-one component at op X is -(sourceShift X (-1)).inv.app M, and its degree-minus-one inverse component is (sourceShift X 1).hom.app M. Here sourceShift is the uniquely normalized signed comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction]. M is arbitrary; no bidual or evaluation transformation occurs.

proof.text: Represent M by a K-injective I using essential surjectivity of the K-injective subcategory under Q. The ordinary-to-derived comparison is an isomorphism for every source complex. Compose it with the chosen isomorphism Q(I) ≅ M to obtain a natural isomorphism Hom(-,I) ⋙ Q ≅ Q.op ⋙ T_M.

source.place: Tags 0A8X, 08J9, 08JC and 0A97; explicit signed Hom-complex calculation

proof.text: Use the already proved ordinarySignedCommShift for the naive opposite source and negative target pullback, with source parameter m and correction m(m-1)/2. Pull both shifts back along negation and identify the double-negative target pullback with the original shift. The source is then the triangulated opposite and the correction for n is n(n+1)/2. Descend the coherent structure through localization, requiring the comparison natural isomorphism to commute with shifts. On a representative E of each X, the full normalization of sourceShift identifies the components at 1 and -1: their correction factors are respectively -1 and 1. Cancel the isomorphism from the representative Hom comparison to obtain the two displayed formulas.

proof.text: Reuse the proved graded cone-summand identities of lem-sf-double-hom-cone-comparison. With g = Hom(f,I), define a map mappingCocone(g) → Hom(mappingCone(f),I) by inB on the G summand and (-1)^q inA on the E summand of degree q+1. The differential identities make this a chain map; the two projections give an explicit degreewise inverse. The first two triangle squares follow from the summand formulas. For the third square, the reversed cone boundary has component minus fst in degree p-1; combine this with the negative raw source comparison at 1 and the source-reindexing projection formula. The signs cancel, giving exactly the mapping-cocone boundary. Apply Q, transport across the shift-compatible comparison, and use the representation of every distinguished derived triangle by a localized cone triangle (also in the opposite category).

lean.statement:
theorem signedDerivedInternalHom_exact (M : D.{c, v, r, w} J R) :
    let T := Prod.sectL _ M ⋙ derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R
    ∃ S : T.CommShift ℤ,
      (fun [_shiftInst : T.CommShift ℤ] ↦ T.IsTriangulated ∧
        (∀ X : D.{c, v, r, w} J R,
          (T.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app (op X) =
            -(sourceShift.{c, v, r, w} J R X (-1)).inv.app M) ∧
        (∀ X : D.{c, v, r, w} J R,
          (T.commShiftIso (-1 : ℤ)).inv.app (op X) =
            (sourceShift.{c, v, r, w} J R X 1).hom.app M)) (_shiftInst := S)
